errors.evidence: The label showing 1.1% corresponds to 'Mix-Sound-Music', not 'Mix-Sound-Speech'. The description swaps the labels for the 1.1% and 2.4% slices.
The label showing 2.4% corresponds to 'Mix-Sound-Music-Speech', not 'Mix-Sound-Music'. The description has incorrect label-percentage pairings for these two slices.
The 8.2% slice is labeled 'Mix-Music-Speech' in the figure, not 'Mix-Sound-Speech'.

The chart actually has seven slices (Mix-Sound-Music 1.1%, Mix-Sound-Music-Speech 2.4%, Mix-Music-Speech 8.2%, Speech 29.4%, Mix-Sound-Speech 21.8%, Music 20.6%, Sound 16.5%), but only six are listed in the sentence before 'as well as' adds one more, creating confusion.
The chart is a donut chart (with a hollow center), not a standard pie chart. This structural feature is not mentioned.

errors.text_span: Percentage labels are included within each slice
errors.evidence: Some percentage labels (for small slices like Mix-Sound-Music 1.1% and Mix-Sound-Music-Speech 2.4%) appear outside the chart with leader lines, not inside the slices.
